svg.title: Vetrix Administrator data flow diagram
svg.desc: 1.1 Manage accounts; 1.2 Verify pets and edit requests; 1.3 Manage clinic schedules; 1.4 Manage inventory and sales; 1.5 Review reports and activity. Labeled arrows show data exchanged with logical stores.
svg.text: Data flow diagram • Simplified Level 1 role view
Rectangle = user • Rounded box = process • Divided box = data store • Arrow = direction of data
Repeated users and store IDs refer to the same entity or store. Rows show data flows, not a sequence of steps.
Selected business processes. Authentication and routine logging are omitted.
